tagline:
Archive your dream today.
Break it into steps you can do.
spoken: [hook] If you save whatever's left at the end of the month, you'll probably save nothing. || Because there's always something. A dinner out, a sale, a bill you forgot about. And by the thirtieth, it's gone, without one big mistake. || [turn] So flip the order. Save first, on the day you get paid, and then spend what's left. || Say you want five thousand dollars in a year. That's about four hundred and seventeen dollars a month. || The trick is to make it automatic. Set up a transfer for the day after payday, into a separate savings account, so it never sits in your spending money. || Can't do four hundred yet? Start with a hundred. The amount can grow later. Paying yourself first is the habit that matters. || [land] Do it today. It takes about five minutes in your banking app, and after that it happens every month without you. || [outro] That's what Dmyor is for. You archive your dream today, so you can see it tomorrow, and break it down into small steps you can actually do. || [outro] If you want to try it out, I've put the link in the bio.

caption.instagram:
If you save what's left at the end of the month, there's usually nothing left.

Flip the order:
• Save first, the day after payday
• $5,000 a year = about $417 a month
• Can't do $417? Start with $100 and grow it
• Set the automatic transfer today (about 5 minutes)
